name: sprint11_qhour_open_spy
hypothesis: Quarter-hour boundary flow clustering (arXiv 2607.09426, an equity VWAP-slicing mechanism) predicts continued 15m drift on SPY 1-min RTH bars -- distinct venue/mechanism from sprint09's crypto FAIL (24/7 fragmented flow, no scheduled algo slicing).
power_argument: Assuming SPY 15-min return stdev ~15bp (typical intraday realized vol, an assumption not a briefing fact): SE at n=300 ~0.87bp, min detectable edge at t=2 ~1.7bp, well below the T2 cost floor (2x10bp fee + slippage, ~20-26bp measured on crypto, comparable order of magnitude here since the flat fee dominates) -- so the design fails on a true null, not by construction. Boundary bars = 26/day (6.5h RTH); cap 8/day x ~63 validation trading days x 1 symbol = up to 504 possible entries, clearing the 300 floor.
